entities.name: Clifford P. Case
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Clifford Philip Case Jr., was an American lawyer and politician. For over 30 years, Case represented the state of New Jersey as a member of the Republican Party in both the U.S. House of Representatives (1945–1953) and the U.S. Senate (1955–1979).
